questions.prompt_markup: Sketch a rough graph of p(x) = -(x + 3)(x - 1)(x - 4). Mark the zeros and the y-intercept, and show the end behavior. (Use the grid for x; the y-scale is up to you.)
questions.correct_answer: A curve that crosses the x-axis at -3, 1, and 4, passes through (0, -12) (below the grid is fine), rises to the left and falls to the right
questions.grading_note: Any correct sketch: three crossings and the end behavior of a cubic with negative leading coefficient. p(0) = -(3)(-1)(-4) = -12.
